rules.description: Static radar calibration after radar removal/install.
rules.reason: The radar sensor itself was removed, replaced, or adjusted. The measurement plane the sensor was set to at the factory has been disturbed, so the applicable OEM procedure must be retrieved and followed.
evidenceRequired: Estimate line showing the radar operation
OEM procedure for the exact sensor part number and vehicle configuration

rules.description: Post-repair radar fault-code and alignment check.

conditions.label: Wheel alignment was performed on this repair order

rules.reason: A disconnected connector, a disturbed mounting bracket, or a wheel alignment can each change what the radar sees after a repair; the OEM procedure defines which diagnostic check applies.
evidenceRequired: Whether the radar bracket was disturbed

rules.description: Static forward-camera calibration after glass replacement.

conditions.label: A sensor mounted to the glass is in the affected set for this line
Glass was not removed without disturbing the sensor bracket

rules.reason: Windshield replacement moves or re-seats the glass that the forward camera is aimed through; where a camera is present, the OEM procedure defines a static calibration using a target board.
evidenceRequired: Sensor package for the vehicle configuration
Whether the camera bracket was disturbed

conditions.label: A sensor mounted to the glass is in the affected set for this line
Static calibration cannot be performed in the shop

rules.reason: Some configurations require a drive-cycle calibration instead of, or in addition to, a static one; the OEM procedure for the exact configuration decides which.
evidenceRequired: OEM calibration method for the configuration
Shop capability for the required static target setup

rules.description: Inspect the radar mounting and aim after front bumper cover work.

conditions.label: Radar mounting is attached to the structure disturbed by this line
Repair was triggered by a moderate or severe impact

rules.reason: Cover work can leave the radar's bracket or aim out of position even when the sensor was not replaced; an inspection determines whether a calibration procedure is then needed.
evidenceRequired: Radar mounting location for the configuration
Impact severity band from the repair order

source.section: Front body repairs and sensor aim

rules.description: Initialize front parking sensors after cover replacement.

conditions.label: Parking sensors were transferred from the old cover to the new one
Cover was replaced with a non-OEM part

rules.reason: Transferring or replacing parking sensors changes the reference surface they measure from; the OEM procedure defines any required initialization.
evidenceRequired: Whether the replacement cover is OEM

rules.description: Initialize a replaced forward camera before calibration.

conditions.label: The camera itself was replaced (not just removed and re-installed)
OEM calibration equipment is not known to be unavailable

rules.reason: A new camera module has no stored aim; initialization and then calibration are required in the order the OEM procedure specifies.
evidenceRequired: Whether OEM calibration equipment is available

rules.description: Check blind-spot radar after side mirror replacement.

conditions.label: Blind-spot radar is mounted in the mirror housing on this configuration
Mirror was replaced with an OEM part

rules.reason: Where the radar lives in the mirror housing, replacing the housing moves the radar; the OEM procedure defines the check and any following calibration.
evidenceRequired: Radar mounting location for the configuration
